principle: Production already HAS these functions/tables. Apply plan = align repo history + tighten over-exposed grants ONLY; do not recreate existing objects blindly.
per_migration: Preflight: check object existence; tables use CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS (already present in prod -> skip); functions use CREATE OR REPLACE (safe); apply the 10 security-fix function replacements + grant revoke/regrant.
production_security_fix: The 10 over-exposed readers must be CREATE OR REPLACE-d in Production with the admin guard (this is the real prod security remediation).
rollback: CREATE OR REPLACE back to prior definition (captured hashes); tables not dropped in prod.
verification: re-run read-only metadata query; confirm guard present + grants tightened.
